title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
abstract: arXiv:2611.31185v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GR

translated_title: CO-GRAFT：通过角色级策略嫁接归因搜索智能体中强化学习的增益
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）可以将大型语言模型搜索智能体的性能较其强化学习前的初始版本提升多达32个精确匹配（EM）分值，然而整体准确率的提升并不能识别出在训练过程中哪些底层功能能力得到了改善或发生了交互作用。我们提出了CO-GRAFT，这是一个与奖励无关的干预式归因框架，其中经过强化学习训练的智能体与其强化学习前的初始版本在闭环执行和实时检索的条件下联合生成单条轨迹。每个策略控制四个功能角色中互斥的一个子集：中间推理、搜索或回答决策、搜索查询生成以及最终答案提取。在不修改权重或重新训练的情况下评估所有2^4=16种角色分配，这定义了一个合作博弈，其Shapley值将总的强化学习增益分解到各个角色上，而Möbius交互项则区分了单个角色的独立改进与多角色之间的耦合效应。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出CO-GRAFT框架，通过角色级策略嫁接与合作博弈的Shapley值分解，将强化学习为搜索智能体带来的整体准确率提升归因到中间推理、搜索决策、查询生成和答案提取四个功能角色上，并利用Möbius交互项区分角色独立改进与多角色耦合效应。
en_tdlr: CO-GRAFT is a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework that decomposes RL gains in search agents across four functional roles via role-level policy grafting, Shapley values, and Möbius interaction terms.
